chapter: Chicago, Detroit and Seattle Harmony Kings
title: Chicago's jazz scene of the Austin High crowd and Earl Hines
summary: Willard lists Teschemacher, Condon, Freeman and Goodman; Davison says he was too busy with his band to hear much of it.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Okay -- so, you had that one record, but can we throw in something -- a lot of people when they heard you in Chicago - they think of the Austin High School Band and they think of Teschemacher and Eddie Condon and Bud Freeman and Benny Goodman -- and all those guys; they were just about to get ready to start along about this time -- the same time Earl Hines was coming into Chicago---
Now, all of these people were there and, uh, you were there and everybody else was there -- so, this was really a big jazz time - right?
Yes, but it wasn't not quite for me yet---
